description: Hidalgo County Appraisal District. No bulk file URL could be retrieved. See docs/registry/sources/tx-hidalgo-cad.md.

sources.notes: The district's site (hidalgoad.org) is a True Prodigy 'Public Portal' single-page app. Fetched without JavaScript it returns an empty shell (title 'Public Portal'); in a desktop browser pane it rendered blank at /data-downloads and /. robots.txt returns the app shell, so there are no rules. A search index lists www.hidalgoad.org/data-downloads as 'Data Downloads' (shapefiles and GIS data, parcel data joined to appraisal data monthly as a DBF table, certified exports including a TYP mineral export), but no file URL was seen. The portal's content comes from a vendor API (prod-container.trueprodigyapi.com) that identifies the district by the requesting origin; reaching it by presenting another site's origin headers would be circumvention and was not done. Needs a person to open the page and copy the file URLs.
